what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/read-and-write-gmail: one http row per Gmail request the mail screen makes (search, read, organize, trash and restore mail and threads, drafts, send-as signatures), each run as the Google account its input's connection names.

payload.label: Clear primary email signature
payload.job: Clear the primary Gmail SendAs signature by sending an empty signature to the exact sendAsEmail where isPrimary is true in list_send_as. The provider response is the saved value; read list_send_as again to verify. This operation does not manage aliases.
payload.description: Clear the primary Gmail SendAs signature by sending an empty signature to the exact sendAsEmail where isPrimary is true in list_send_as. The provider response is the saved value; read list_send_as again to verify. This operation does not manage aliases. Runs as the Google account the input's connection names, with the value the person's vault holds for it (placed only as the request leaves, never shown).

send_as_email.description: The exact SendAs email where isPrimary is true in list_send_as for this same connected account.

connection_id.description: The Google account to use: service_connection:google-account or service_connection:google-account:<account>, as the person's connections list it

connected_at.description: When that account was connected, so a reconnected account is a new one (not read by the run)

connection.description: The person's Google account this run uses, by its handle only
